stem_book: A rod of mass m and length ℓ is doing combined motion: its centre moves with velocity υ along +x while the rod (held vertical at this instant) spins clockwise with ω = 4υ/ℓ. The point O lies a perpendicular distance ℓ/4 below the line of υ (see figure). Its angular momentum about O is: (a) (7/12)mvℓ (b) (5/12)mvℓ (c) (7/6)mvℓ (d) (5/6)mvℓ
reason: Figure prints ω = 4υ/R for a rod with no R — misprint for 4υ/ℓ (the only reading that gives a listed option); corrected in stem. Printed key a agrees.
work: L = m υ(ℓ/4) + (mℓ²/12)(4υ/ℓ), both clockwise = mυℓ(1/4 + 1/3) = (7/12)mυℓ
